name: Lystra

related_people.name: Eunice
related_people.role: Timothy's mother, a believing woman of this town

related_people.name: Lois
related_people.role: Timothy's grandmother, in whose household sincere faith took root

related_people.name: Timothy
related_people.role: the disciple of this town, well spoken of, whom Paul took as a companion

description: A city in Asia Minor where Paul healed a man lame from birth, prompting the crowd to try to worship him and Barnabas as gods before the same crowd, incited by opponents, stoned Paul and left him for dead (Acts 14:8-20). Timothy, whose grandmother Lois and mother Eunice had genuine faith, was from Lystra (2 Timothy 1:5).
